objective: Define the engineering architecture and sequence for Harness V2 infrastructure upgrades.
progression_rule: M(n+1) cannot begin until M(n) has: 1. completed implementation, 2. passed deterministic tests, 3. produced required evidence, 4. passed its milestone gate, 5. zero unresolved safety/governance blockers, 6. received explicit external authorization for the next milestone. No automatic progression.

milestones.name: Contracts & Immutable Invariants
milestones.scope: Formally encode the invariants that all Harness V2 milestones inherit. Prevent accidental modification of holdout, live authorization, and historical records.
tests: test_v2_invariants.py (Verify Holdout path-denial and LIVE blocking without reading actual Holdout data)
milestones.rollback: Remove only the specific artifacts (V2_INVARIANTS.json, test_v2_invariants.py) introduced by M0. Must NOT mutate historical receipts, candidates, gates, ledgers, research generations, or holdout state.
acceptance_criteria: V2_INVARIANTS.json exists, contains all inherited_immutable_invariants keys, and validates against JSON schema.
test_v2_invariants.py executes and returns exit code 0.
test_v2_invariants.py includes a mock path-denial test that asserts FINAL_HOLDOUT read attempts raise PermissionError.
harness validate completes with exit code 0 and verifies 0 holdout accesses.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M0 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M1.

milestones.name: Context Budget Manager / Context Manifests
milestones.scope: Implement fail-closed context manifests tracking provenance and bounding prompt budgets without silently degrading governance.
milestone_specific_invariants: Context failure on safety/governance sources MUST yield status = BLOCKED with a deterministic reason_code.
tests: test_context_manager.py (Inject failures for missing files, SHA mismatches, and budget exceedance to verify fail-closed behavior)
milestones.rollback: Remove context_manifest.schema.json and context_manager.py. Must not alter historical data.
acceptance_criteria: context_manifest.schema.json requires schema_version, manifest_id, task_id, created_at, baseline_id, candidate_id, role, context_budget, and an array of sources with SHA-256 hashes.
A missing required source explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_SOURCE_MISSING.
A SHA-256 mismatch explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_HASH_MISMATCH.
An expired summary explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_STALE.
Exceeding context_budget explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.
An unauthorized source explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_UNAUTHORIZED_SOURCE.
A structurally invalid manifest explicitly sets status = BLOCKED and reason_code = CONTEXT_INVALID.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M1 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M2.

milestones.name: Machine Tool Manifest + Role Enforcement
milestones.scope: Define tool ACLs enforcing that roles cannot rely merely on prompt instructions. Block CODER from self-certifying.
milestone_specific_invariants: CODER role execution of harness.certify MUST exit with code 1.
acceptance_criteria: Executing certify tool with CODER role yields PermissionError or exit code 1.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M2 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M3.

milestones.name: Write Leases
milestones.scope: Implement atomic file-level write leases tracking owner, role, and expiration to prevent parallel mutations.
milestone_specific_invariants: Governance critical paths (PROJECT_STATE.json, gates/, receipts/) MUST strictly reject non-CERTIFIER/non-AUDITOR write leases.
acceptance_criteria: Attempting concurrent write lease acquisition on the same file returns LeaseConflict error.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M3 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M4.

milestones.name: AI Judge Hardening
milestones.scope: Migrate AI Judge default to NOT_EVALUATED/AI_UNAVAILABLE explicitly preventing silent authorization on failure.
milestone_specific_invariants: AI failure MUST NEVER grant execution authority.
milestones.rollback: Revert delta in core/ai_judge.py. Do not alter historical executions.
acceptance_criteria: Mocking AI timeout returns AI_UNAVAILABLE and deterministic policy subsequently rejects execution.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M4 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M5.

milestones.name: Typed Diagnostic States + Minimal Hooks
milestones.scope: Add reason_code (TIMEOUT, REGRESSION, etc.) while preserving status = PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED.
milestone_specific_invariants: status field MUST only accept PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED.
milestones.rollback: Revert delta in execution.schema.json and remove hooks.py.
acceptance_criteria: Validating historical PASS/FAIL receipts against the updated schema returns true.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M5 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M6.

milestones.name: Legacy Test Migration
milestones.scope: Classify the 47 legacy failures/errors via evidence and migrate valid historical tests to append-only verifiers.
milestone_specific_invariants: Historical evidence MUST NOT be rewritten.
milestones.rollback: Revert modified test files to their baseline sha256. Remove KNOWN_FAILURES.json.
acceptance_criteria: All 47 failing tests are mapped to exactly one evidence-backed classification in KNOWN_FAILURES.json.
milestones.stop_boundary: After M6 gate PASS, stop and await external authorization for M7.

milestones.name: Git Adoption
milestones.scope: Initialize Git for diffs and rollback. Exclude sensitive and generated files.
milestone_specific_invariants: FINAL_HOLDOUT contents MUST NOT be committed.

verification_plan.instructions: Do not execute implementation. Await external review. Validate schema and structural constraints only.
